∀ {V : Type u_1} {W : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
  [inst_2 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} W] [inst_3 : Module.{0, u_2} Complex W]
  (ρV :
    LieHom.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x)
      (Module.End.{0, u_1} Complex V))
  (ρW :
    LieHom.{0, 0, u_2} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x)
      (Module.End.{0, u_2} Complex W))
  (f : LinearMap.{0, 0, u_1, u_2} (RingHom.id.{0} Complex) V W),
  Iff
    (∀ (x : Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) (v : V),
      Eq.{u_2 + 1}
        (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} f
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1} ρV x) v))
        (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, 1, u_2 + 1} ρW x)
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} f v)))
    (∀ (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.{0, 0} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x))
      (v : V),
      Eq.{u_2 + 1}
        (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} f
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1}
            (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1}
              (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) 1, max (u_1 + 1) 1, max (u_1 + 1) 1}
                (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift.{0, 0, u_1} Complex) ρV)
              u)
            v))
        (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1}
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, 1, u_2 + 1}
            (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_2 + 1) 1, max (u_2 + 1) 1, max (u_2 + 1) 1}
              (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift.{0, 0, u_2} Complex) ρW)
            u)
          (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} f v)))

∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
  (ρ :
    LieHom.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x)
      (Module.End.{0, u_1} Complex V))
  (W : Submodule.{0, u_1} Complex V),
  Iff
    (∀ (x : Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x) (v : V),
      Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} W v →
        Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} W
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1} ρ x) v))
    (∀ (u : UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.{0, 0} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x))
      (v : V),
      Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} W v →
        Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} W
          (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1, u_1 + 1}
            (DFunLike.coe.{u_1 + 1, 1, u_1 + 1}
              (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) 1, max (u_1 + 1) 1, max (u_1 + 1) 1}
                (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.lift.{0, 0, u_1} Complex) ρ)
              u)
            v))

(V : Type u_1) →
  [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] →
    [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V] →
      Equiv.{max (u_1 + 1) 1, max (u_1 + 1) 1}
        (LieHom.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x)
          (Module.End.{0, u_1} Complex V))
        (AlgHom.{0, 0, u_1} Complex
          (UniversalEnvelopingAlgebra.{0, 0} Complex (Subtype.{1} fun x => Membership.mem.{0, 0} Etingof.sl2 x))
          (Module.End.{0, u_1} Complex V))
